output.source_text: A single Half-Whole Diminished scale fits four dominant 7th chords built a minor 3rd apart (e.g., C7, Eb7, F#7, A7). A C half-whole diminished scale can be conceptualized as combining the top half of C7 and the top half of its tritone sub Gb7 (F#7).

note_vi: Bài 22 của nguồn Jazz Scales (YouTube), mốc 06:48-08:33. A single Half-Whole Diminished scale fits four dominant 7th chords built a minor 3rd apart (e.g., C7, Eb7, F#7, A7). A C half-whole diminished scale can be conceptualized as combining the top half of C7 and the top half of its tritone sub Gb7 (F#7). Nguồn giảng bằng tiếng Anh, câu trên giữ nguyên lời giảng.
